selected.title: What TransLink fares cost after the July increase
selected.hypothesis: A current fare explainer should earn repeat utility because riders need exact post-increase amounts for Compass loading, passes, airport trips, and cross-zone planning.
selected.singleChangedVariable: Add a region-wide price utility bulletin instead of another event-only transit piece.
selected.duplicateCheck: No exact or near-topic match found for TransLink fare increase, Compass fares, or July fare increase in content or editorial learning.

facts: TransLink page says fares increased by an average of 5% on July 1, 2026.
Adult monthly passes: $117.20, $156.70, and $211.65; concession monthly pass: $66.95.
Journeys starting at YVR-Airport, Sea Island Centre, or Templeton stations include a $6.50 YVR Airport AddFare at all times.
The page says buses and HandyDART are 1-Zone at all times; SkyTrain and SeaBus vary by zone and time; single fares are valid for 90 minutes.

selected.title: Free Burnaby park events to plan this week
selected.hypothesis: A concise, source-linked family planning bulletin should perform better than generic event aggregation because it answers dates, times, location, price, weather caveat, and parking/transit choice.
selected.singleChangedVariable: Use two official Burnaby park-event pages to create a practical this-week planner for families.
selected.duplicateCheck: No exact or near-topic match found for Summer Stages, Jim Lorimer Park reopening, or Burnaby free park events in existing local content.

facts: City of Burnaby Summer Stages page says the series runs July 14-August 27, 2026 at Confederation Park, 250 Willingdon Ave, by the spray park.
Summer Stages page lists Tuesday and Wednesday shows at 11 am, 12:15 pm, and 2:30 pm; Thursday Family Nights from 5:30-8:30 pm.
Summer Stages page says events run rain or shine, but may be cancelled due to extreme weather, and asks readers to check the page for updates.
Summer Stages July 21 listing includes Vancouver Puppet Theatre, The Trollsons, and Cosmo's Pop Up Clown Circus.
Summer Stages July 22 listing includes Russell Hirsch storytelling, Kellie Haines ventriloquism, and Zlatna Mountain Balkan Folk Music.
Summer Stages July 23 evening listing includes Celtic Cowboys, Vancouver Morris Men, and The Colours of Juggling featuring Yuki & Friends.
Jim Lorimer Park Re-opening Celebration page lists Wed, Jul 22 2026, 1-2 pm, at 2338 Gilmore Ave.
Jim Lorimer page says the event includes free ice cream while supplies last, brand-new playground equipment, a new play tower and slide, swings and spinners, and a dedicated toddler play area.
Jim Lorimer page says there is an official ribbon-cutting at 1 pm.
Jim Lorimer page says there is no parking onsite and recommends walking, rolling, cycling, or riding SkyTrain to Gilmore SkyTrain Station next to the park.

sources.name: City of Burnaby Jim Lorimer Park Re-opening Celebration
